faqs.question: Is Punaluu Black Sand Beach good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. Sharp lava rock. There are no lifeguards.

faqs.question: Is Makena Beach good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. Coral and lava rock in the shallows cause cuts. There are no lifeguards.

faqs.question: Is Wailea Beach good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. Shallow lava rock and coral; there is no lifeguard on most of the beach.

faqs.question: Is Lanikai Beach good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. Shallow coral heads and lava rock cause cuts. There is no lifeguard at Lanikai, so swim near the wall or with a local.

faqs.question: Is Makapuu Tide Pools good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. Sharks are present here, including tiger shark and oceanic whitetip. Never swim alone, keep a watch on the water, and stay inside the reef.

faqs.question: Is Manoa Bay good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. Reef cuts, and a steep drop-off at the north end. There is no lifeguard.

faqs.question: Is Little Eggs Beach good for beginners?
faqs.answer: No. It is for experienced snorkelers only. A rough rock entry, kelp and marine life in the shallows, and swell. The Catalina Channel can build strong currents.

faqs.question: Is Camp Cactus good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. Rocky entry and a steep drop-off. Catalina Channel swell can make this a rough place in winter.

faqs.question: Is Scripps Pier good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. Strong rip currents run around the pier pilings. Never swim off the Scripps pier, and note there is no lifeguard on the pier itself.

faqs.question: Is Sunset Cliffs Marine Reserve good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. Rocky entry, heavy surf and rip currents. This is a snorkel-and-dive site, not a swim beach.

faqs.question: Is Rainbow Springs State Park good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. Glass-clear water with very low visibility beyond a few feet. Do not dive into the cave. There is no lifeguard.

faqs.question: Is Gilchrist Blue Springs good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. Visibility drops after heavy rain, and the pool has a steep drop-off on the upstream side.

faqs.question: Is Fanning Springs State Park good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. A very strong current runs out of the spring and into the river, and swimming against it is exhausting. There is no lifeguard.

faqs.question: Is Manatee Springs State Park good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. The river can be deep in places. Do not get in the water directly over the spring head: a floating person can be pulled down.

faqs.question: Is John Pennekamp State Park good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. A dive flag is required by state law for snorkelers and divers in the park, and the current runs hard along the reef edge.

faqs.question: Is Dry Tortugas National Park good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. Heat, sun exposure and dehydration are the real dangers here. The moat wall has heavy surge and the reef drop-offs come up fast.

faqs.question: Is Old Seven Mile Bridge Piles good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. The remains of the old bridge are shallow, barnacle-covered and sharp. Stay clear of the current bridge piers.

faqs.question: Is Sand Key Lighthouse good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. The trip out is open water with heavy boat traffic, and the islet has no shade and no freshwater.

faqs.question: Is Datura Avenue Reef good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. This is a street-access beach with no lifeguard. Watch for boat traffic and stay clear of the pier and the channel.

faqs.question: Is Shipwreck Snorkel Trail good for beginners?
faqs.answer: It suits confident swimmers better than first-timers. Boat traffic is the main risk. The pier is closed for reconstruction, so there is construction activity around the shoreline.

faqs.question: Is SS Copenhagen good for beginners?
faqs.answer: No. It is for experienced snorkelers only. Currents at the site are mild, but the site sits outside the protected swim zone and boat traffic is heavy.

faqs.question: Is Crandon Park good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the easier spots in the area. The shoreline stays shallow for a long way out, which makes this a good beginner beach. Watch the boat channel markers and stay on the ocean side.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Punaluu Black Sand Beach?
faqs.answer: Early morning. Turtles are usually on the sand near dawn. The river above the beach is freshwater and can carry bacteria. Do not swim above the surf line.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Makena Beach?
faqs.answer: Year-round, best in the morning. Winter swells are noticeably calmer on this side of the island.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Wailea Beach?
faqs.answer: Best in the morning. Calmest from autumn through spring.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Lanikai Beach?
faqs.answer: Year-round. The calmest and clearest water is from late spring through early autumn. A big winter northerly swell makes the outer reef dangerous; stay inside the lagoon.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Makapuu Tide Pools?
faqs.answer: Low tide on a calm weekday. Check the Waimanalo tide table before you drive out. The outer shelf takes a direct hit from large swells. Stay in the pools and the inner reef when the surf is up.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Manoa Bay?
faqs.answer: Mornings, year-round.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Little Eggs Beach?
faqs.answer: Summer and early autumn, when the water is calmest and warmest. The north end of the beach is a protected cove for marine mammals and is closed to swimmers.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Camp Cactus?
faqs.answer: Summer and early autumn.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Scripps Pier?
faqs.answer: Best near high tide. The tidewalk runs for roughly two hours before and after high tide. The water is often green with plankton and visibility can be poor on windy days.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Sunset Cliffs Marine Reserve?
faqs.answer: Summer for the kelp forest. A winter swell is common. Mornings are calmest. Swell surges into the caves and surge channels, so go with a guide if you are not confident in a rocky entry.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Rainbow Springs State Park?
faqs.answer: Year-round. The water holds 72 degrees all year, so winter is the best value.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Gilchrist Blue Springs?
faqs.answer: Year-round. The water is 68-70 degrees. The river current can pick up quickly after rain. Stay out of the main channel and do not swim upstream of the spring pool.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Fanning Springs State Park?
faqs.answer: Year-round. The water is 72 degrees, and manatees are more likely in the cooler months.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Manatee Springs State Park?
faqs.answer: Best on a weekday morning, year-round. The water is about 68-70 degrees.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel John Pennekamp State Park?
faqs.answer: Year-round. The clearest water is usually in summer.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Dry Tortugas National Park?
faqs.answer: The island is visitable year-round, but the water is usually calmest in summer. There is no freshwater and almost no shade on the island. Boat passage can be cancelled in rough weather.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Old Seven Mile Bridge Piles?
faqs.answer: Year-round, best on a calm day.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Sand Key Lighthouse?
faqs.answer: Summer for calm water and clear visibility. Boat passage to the islet can be cancelled in rough weather.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Datura Avenue Reef?
faqs.answer: Year-round. Calmest on a weekday morning, and the reef is close enough to shore to snorkel in almost any conditions.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Shipwreck Snorkel Trail?
faqs.answer: Year-round, on a calm day with low swell. The trail markers are small pairs of yellow buoys and are easy to miss from the surface.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel SS Copenhagen?
faqs.answer: Year-round on calm days. Visibility is usually best in summer. This is a dive site rather than a snorkel site: the wreck lies well below snorkel depth and it is a protected historic site.

faqs.question: When is the best time to snorkel Crandon Park?
faqs.answer: Year-round. Mornings are calmest and the water is clearest in winter.

faqs.question: Can you snorkel Lauderdale-by-the-Sea without a tour?

faqs.question: Can you snorkel Florida Keys without a tour?

faqs.question: What is the best beginner snorkeling in Lauderdale-by-the-Sea?

faqs.question: What is the best beginner snorkeling in Florida Keys?

faqs.question: Is Lanikai Beach good for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is one of the best beginner snorkels in Hawaii. The water is shallow inside the reef, the entry is a sandy bottom and there is a lifeguard on the beach at Lanikai Beach Park, though none at the Lanikai end.

faqs.question: Can you swim in the Rainbow Springs cave?
faqs.answer: No. The cave is 400 ft long but it is closed to swimmers because of the low roof and the risk of getting lost in the dark. Swim the pool beside it instead.

faqs.question: Can you swim in the spring bowl at Fanning Springs?
faqs.answer: No. The spring bowl is a protected area and the current pouring out of it is strong enough to sweep a swimmer downstream. Stay in the river run below the spring.

faqs.question: Can I snorkel from the beach at John Pennekamp?
faqs.answer: Yes, the reef starts at the sand, which is what makes it unusual. Most visitors go out on the glass-bottom boat, a 65-foot catamaran that carries up to 130 passengers.

faqs.question: How big is John Pennekamp?
faqs.answer: The reef tract covers roughly 70 to 72 square nautical miles and runs about 21 miles from the park out to the edge of the shelf. It was established in 1959 and was the world’s first undersea park.

faqs.question: How many wrecks are in the Dry Tortugas?
faqs.answer: More than 300, which is why the area is a magnet for divers. The Windjammer, a schooner that sank in the 1960s, sits in about 20 ft of water and is a snorkelable wreck.

faqs.question: Are there crocodiles at Dry Tortugas?
faqs.answer: Yes. American crocodiles live in the moat around Fort Jefferson and around the brackish ponds on the island. They are wild and they are protected. Keep your distance and never swim in the moat.

faqs.question: How far out is the Datura Avenue reef?
faqs.answer: About 100 yards offshore. The reef steps down in three tiers, and the first one is shallow enough to snorkel on. It is unusually close to shore for a Florida reef, which makes it a good first Florida snorkel.

faqs.question: When was the Shipwreck Snorkel Trail dedicated?
faqs.answer: In 2002, with Jean-Michele Cousteau present. The Marine Archaeological Council, the nonprofit he inspired, maintains the trail and its markers today.

faqs.question: What am I actually swimming over?
faqs.answer: The SS Copenhagen, a British steamship that ran aground in May 1900 less than a mile offshore. It was broken up for scrap in the 1970s, and the trail was laid over the debris field: the anchor, five concrete cannon and a ballast pile sit at 10 ft.

faqs.question: Why is the SS Copenhagen protected?
faqs.answer: Because it was declared a Florida Underwater Archaeological Preserve in 1994. That means the site may not be touched, moved or salvaged, and spearfishing and any form of take are prohibited.
